# LucidAccuracy

> LucidAccuracy is a global workforce, technology and AI solutions company helping organizations worldwide build teams, solve technology challenges and automate business operations.

LucidAccuracy serves organizations in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, Europe and India. It has U.S. offices in Sacramento (California), Glastonbury (Connecticut) and Canton (Ohio). Contact: Info@lucidaccuracy.com, +1 307-999-9564, or the request form at https://lucidaccuracy.com/contact/. The team replies within 24–48 hours.

LucidAccuracy is also written as "Lucid Accuracy". It is not only a recruitment agency: recruitment is one of six solution lines alongside technology delivery, an AI calling product, training, consulting and business process work. C2C, W2 and contract-to-hire engagement models apply to U.S.-based roles only.

## Solutions

- [Recruitment & Workforce Solutions](https://lucidaccuracy.com/solutions/recruitment-workforce/): Permanent recruitment, contract staffing, temporary and flexible workforce, executive and specialized hiring, workforce management, recruitment process support and talent acquisition support.
- [Technology Solutions](https://lucidaccuracy.com/solutions/technology/): Software and application development, cloud, data and analytics, AI and automation, cybersecurity, digital transformation and managed IT support.
- [Training & Professional Development](https://lucidaccuracy.com/solutions/training/): Corporate training, technology training, upskilling and reskilling, professional development and certification support.
- [Consulting & Professional Services](https://lucidaccuracy.com/solutions/consulting/): Workforce consulting, technology consulting and business transformation.
- [Business Process Solutions](https://lucidaccuracy.com/solutions/business-process/): Back-office operations, customer support, process management and business support.

## Products

- [LucidAI Calling Agent](https://lucidaccuracy.com/ai-calling-agent/): An AI voice agent that automates inbound and outbound phone conversations: lead qualification, appointment scheduling, answering frequently asked questions, automated follow-ups and call reporting, available 24/7.

- [About LucidAccuracy](https://lucidaccuracy.com/about/): Company overview, the three core businesses (People, Technology, AI) and how engagements run.
- [Industries](https://lucidaccuracy.com/industries/): Technology and IT, healthcare, engineering, finance and accounting, pharmaceutical and life sciences, manufacturing, logistics, telecommunications, retail, energy, and business and professional services.
- [Technology & AI](https://lucidaccuracy.com/technology-ai/): Technology capabilities and AI products.
- [Projects](https://lucidaccuracy.com/projects/): Case studies across workforce, technology, AI, training and business process work.
- [Global Presence](https://lucidaccuracy.com/global-presence/): Markets served and U.S. office addresses.
- [Careers](https://lucidaccuracy.com/careers/): How to find roles with LucidAccuracy and its clients.
- [Contact](https://lucidaccuracy.com/contact/): Request form (choose the services you need), phone and email. Replies within 24–48 hours.
